<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918225_theRebbe_77" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918225_theRebbe_77__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the "ships" represent Torah and mitzvos, which serve as garments enabling the soul to engage in the spiritual commerce of refining the world without being nullified, and that these mitzvos are rooted in the limitless Awtsmoos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And in more particularity,</t>
    <t s="1">this matter is accomplished through Torah and mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="2">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="3">for it is written,</t>
    <t s="4">"She was like merchant ships, from afar she brings her bread,"</t>
    <t s="5">which refers to the Congregation of Israel, who is compared to a merchant,</t>
    <t s="6">as explained in Torah Or</t>
    <t s="7">regarding the matter of "Canaan" in holiness, which means merchant,</t>
    <t s="8">like a merchant who scatters money in order to profit and earn more,</t>
    <t s="9">and its parallel is the entirety of the matter of the descent of the soul below to engage in the commerce of refining and purifying the matters of the world, to make for Him a dwelling place in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="10">And the order of commerce is that they transport and bring merchandise from sea to dry land and from dry land to sea by means of ships,</t>
    <t s="11">and in the language of the Zohar,</t>
    <t s="12">"ships that ascend and descend in the sea,"</t>
    <t s="13">for specifically through them can the creatures on dry land cross and transport merchandise from sea to dry land and from dry land to sea without drowning in the sea,</t>
    <t s="14">and its meaning in the allegory,</t>
    <t s="15">that in order that the soul not drown in the contemplation of the supernal intellect, which is the intellect of the hidden world that is in the aspect of sea,</t>
    <t s="16">there is a need for ships,</t>
    <t s="17">which refer to Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="18">which become garments for the soul, by whose power it can reach the level of unity with Him in a manner that it will not be nullified from its existence.</t>
    <t s="19">For,</t>
    <t s="20">even though the soul has garments from its own side,</t>
    <t s="21">as it is said,</t>
    <t s="22">"But man walks in a likeness,"</t>
    <t s="23">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="24">due to its descent below, the garments can be improper,</t>
    <t s="25">and therefore there is a need for the garments of Torah and mitzvos, through which the garments of the soul are rectified,</t>
    <t s="26">and then the soul has the power below to attain the level of unity with Him without its existence being nullified.</t>
    <t s="27">And likewise regarding the entirety of the drawing down from world to world,</t>
    <t s="28">from the hidden world to the revealed world,</t>
    <t s="29">in a manner that the creatures on dry land will not be nullified from their existence,</t>
    <t s="30">the power for this is through the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos, which are clothed in the matters of the world.</t>
    <t s="31">And the entirety of the matter in this,</t>
    <t s="32">that Torah and mitzvos are rooted and drawn from His very Essence,</t>
    <t s="33">which is above the category of worlds,</t>
    <t s="34">to the extent that the hidden world and the revealed world are equal before Him,</t>
    <t s="35">and therefore through them is drawn the power for the drawing down and revelation from the hidden world to the revealed world,</t>
    <t s="36">as above.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the superiority of the Splitting of the Red Sea, where the sea itself was turned into dry land, meaning the concealment itself became revealed, and this is only possible through the power of the Essence, which allows the creatures to remain intact.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, the superiority of the Splitting of the Red Sea, about which it is said "He turned the sea into dry land," will be explained.</t>
    <t s="2">For,</t>
    <t s="3">the meaning of "He turned the sea into dry land" is not only that something was drawn from the sea to the dry land,</t>
    <t s="4">but more than that,</t>
    <t s="5">the sea itself was turned into dry land,</t>
    <t s="6">that is,</t>
    <t s="7">not only was some drawing down and revelation drawn from the sea to the dry land,</t>
    <t s="8">from the hidden worlds to the revealed worlds</t>
    <t s="9">(which is the matter of "Blessed... from world to world"),</t>
    <t s="10">but more than that,</t>
    <t s="11">the concealment itself came into revelation,</t>
    <t s="12">that is,</t>
    <t s="13">that in the revealed worlds</t>
    <t s="14">(dry land)</t>
    <t s="15">the Divine light was revealed exactly as it is in the hidden worlds</t>
    <t s="16">(sea)</t>
    <t s="17">literally.</t>
    <t s="18">And the verse continues, "They will pass through the river on foot"</t>
    <t s="19">(according to the second interpretation, this also refers to the Splitting of the Red Sea,</t>
    <t s="20">as above in section 1),</t>
    <t s="21">that even though He turned the sea into dry land,</t>
    <t s="22">that in the revealed worlds the Divine light was revealed exactly as it is in the hidden worlds,</t>
    <t s="23">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="24">the existence of the creatures in the revealed world was not changed to be like the creatures of the hidden world,</t>
    <t s="25">the fish of the sea,</t>
    <t s="26">but they remained in their existence as creatures on dry land at that time when they passed through the river and the revelation of the Divine light of the aspect of sea shone upon them,</t>
    <t s="27">as it is written,</t>
    <t s="28">"And the children of Israel walked on dry land in the midst of the sea,"</t>
    <t s="29">in the aspect of "fish of the sea that walk on dry land."</t>
    <t s="30">And the verse there continues, "We will rejoice in Him"</t>
    <t s="31">(this also refers to the Splitting of the Red Sea, as above),</t>
    <t s="32">for this explains how the matter of "He turned the sea into dry land" can be in a manner</t>
    <t s="33">(that they will not be nullified from their existence, but rather)</t>
    <t s="34">that "they will pass through the river on foot,"</t>
    <t s="35">and this is because "there we will rejoice in Him,"</t>
    <t s="36">specifically "in Him,"</t>
    <t s="37">that is, in His Essence.</t>
    <t s="38">And the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="39">that in order for the matter of "He turned the sea into dry land" to occur,</t>
    <t s="40">that the aspect of the concealment in the hidden worlds itself will come and be drawn into revelation in the revealed worlds</t>
    <t s="41">(not just the drawing down of an illumination from the hidden worlds to the revealed worlds),</t>
    <t s="42">this is only through the power of the Essence</t>
    <t s="43">("in Him," in His Essence)</t>
    <t s="44">which is above the categories of sea and dry land, etc.,</t>
    <t s="45">and since this matter is accomplished through the power of the Essence,</t>
    <t s="46">therefore, through the power of the Essence, the revelation of the aspect of sea in dry land,</t>
    <t s="47">"He turned the sea into dry land,"</t>
    <t s="48">will be in a manner that the creatures on dry land will not be nullified from their existence, but rather "they will pass through the river on foot."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the two kindnesses in the verse about the Red Sea: the first is the turning of the sea into dry land, and the second, superior kindness is that Israel passed through without being nullified, which is only possible through the power of the Essence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is also the explanation of the two matters stated in the verse: "To Him who divided the Red Sea into parts, for His kindness endures forever, and made Israel pass through it, for His kindness endures forever."</t>
    <t s="1">For,</t>
    <t s="2">the first kindness is the matter of the Splitting of the Red Sea in itself,</t>
    <t s="3">that He turned the sea into dry land,</t>
    <t s="4">that is,</t>
    <t s="5">that in the revealed worlds the Divine light was revealed exactly as it is in the hidden worlds,</t>
    <t s="6">and this matter in itself is a kindness of Havayah,</t>
    <t s="7">and about this it is said, "To Him who divided the Red Sea into parts, for His kindness endures forever."</t>
    <t s="8">And afterwards the verse adds, "and made Israel pass through it, for His kindness endures forever,"</t>
    <t s="9">this is an additional kindness, that the Children of Israel were not nullified due to the intensity of the revelation of the light of the hidden worlds,</t>
    <t s="10">but rather they walked within the sea on dry land,</t>
    <t s="11">"they will pass through the river on foot."</t>
    <t s="12">And moreover, the second kindness, that He made Israel pass through it, is incomparably more elevated than the first kindness of the Splitting of the Red Sea in itself,</t>
    <t s="13">because,</t>
    <t s="14">the matter of the passing of the Children of Israel within the sea on dry land</t>
    <t s="15">(that they were not nullified by the intensity of the revelation of the sea)</t>
    <t s="16">is specifically through the power of the Essence,</t>
    <t s="17">which is above the categories of sea and dry land, etc.,</t>
    <t s="18">as above.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
